title: Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data The price of bitcoin slid Wednesday after data dropped showing that U.S. consumer prices shot up more than expected in September due to rising gasoline prices. The biggest cryptocurrency by market cap was recently trading for close to $82,827 after dropping nearly 1% over a 24-hour period.
